verified_note: research/title-deeds.json, read 21.10.2026: Sale of Land (Specific Performance) Law 81(I)/2011 as amended (deposit within 6 months, registered-owner condition, search certificate within 5 working days, Forms A/B/C after Law 132/2023), Cap. 96 Streets and Buildings (Certificate of Approval, unauthorised works), Cap. 109 (non-EU permit), DLS e-services and fees, trapped-buyers Law 110(I)/2025. The risk levels per answer are this tool's design, built on the red flags in the law; the lawyer-conflict flag is law-firm advice and is labelled so.

always: Copy of the title deed (Certificate of Registration) for the land or unit, pulled from the DLS.
Search Certificate WITH encumbrances and prohibitions, dated within 5 working days of signing, initialled on every page and attached to the contract.
Search certificate for personal prohibitions on each seller.
Confirmation that each seller is the registered owner (or a distribution agreement signed by all registered owners).
Copy of the official cadastral plan, compared with the plan signed with the contract.
Deposit of the contract at the District Lands Office within 6 months (Form D.E.314, EUR 50) and a copy of the stamped proof of deposit.
After deposit: search certificate for current contracts of the purchaser (EUR 5) to confirm the deposit.
mortgage: Form A signed by the bank, the seller and me, with the 95% amount and the seller's IBAN; confirm no Form C is to be signed.
Confirm there is no MEMO, interim order or other encumbrance besides the mortgage.
Payment schedule tied to the Form A account only; Form B on payment of 95%.
no_title: Planning permit, building permit and division permit with their terms and approved plans.
Certificate of Approval (or with notes / of unauthorised works) for the building and the division, or the date the developer applied.
Horizontal division application number at the DLO and its status.
assignment: Original contract, its DLS proof of deposit, the assignment deposited within 6 months, and the capital gains tax clearance certificate.
Any pending trapped-buyer application on the unit and the bank's written consent.
final: Form N313 tax clearance, municipal tax, sewerage and water certificates before the final payment.
Mortgage release / cancellation document and cancellation of any other encumbrance.
israeli: Cap. 109 permit application (form COMM 145) to the District Administration (no fee, 2-3 weeks) and confirmation that the purchase fits the limits (two units, or one plot up to 4,000 m2).
